title: Account Manager - New Business - Enterprise Sales Germany (m/w/d/x)

- You're involved in designing. Our sales organization is changing itself. We are therefore looking for people who contribute good ideas and further develop enterprise sales.

- Completed university degree, preferably in an economic, technical, IT-related or comparable subject area
- Fluent in German and English
- Experience in B2B sales with demonstrable success in building new business, developing new customer relationships and concluding complex deals. Ideally experience in building relationships at management or C-level

- Experience in technology, cloud, digital or solution sales

- Experience with complex buying centers, major transformation projects or strategic deals
- Willingness to go on business trips within Germany

At T-Systems, we offer our business customers the right system solutions for their digital business.
